quandoUsar: Editing a record or profile without losing the list view, with the form in a side panel.
List filters opened from the left (`side="left"`) and applied on close.
Details of a selected row that stay on screen while the panel leaves, with `useDrawerItem`.
quandoEvitar: Use `dialog` for a short decision that needs full attention.
Use `bottom-sheet` on mobile when the panel should rest at different heights and follow the finger.
Use `resizable-panels` when the side panel is a permanent part of the layout.

teclado.acao: Move through the panel controls without leaving it; on open, focus goes to the first control, the close button.
Closes the panel and returns focus to the `DrawerTrigger`.

acessibilidade: It is a Radix modal dialog: `title` gives the name, `description` the description, focus is trapped in the panel, and the rest of the page leaves the accessibility tree.
The close button is named “Close drawer”, fixed in English in the code.
movimento: The panel enters from the `side` edge on a no-overshoot spring and leaves faster, fading only in the last stretch so the shadow does not vanish abruptly.
The header is the handle: dragging toward the edge moves the panel, the other side resists like elastic, and passing a third of the panel or making a fast gesture closes it keeping the velocity.
With “reduce motion” on, there is no drag and the panel only fades on enter and exit.
responsivo: On the sides the panel is up to 30rem and, below 40rem, takes almost the full width, with smaller corners and spacing; at the top or bottom it takes the full width, up to 32rem tall.
With `container`, the panel opens inside an element, anchored to its edges; that element needs `position: relative` and `overflow: hidden`.
notasIA: Assemble `Drawer`, `DrawerTrigger asChild`, and `DrawerContent` with `title` and `side`; actions that close go in `DrawerClose asChild`. Import from `@/components/ryan-ui/drawer/drawer`.
When opening from a selected row, pass the item through `useDrawerItem(item)` and render the result, so the content does not vanish while the panel leaves.
Drag-to-close only exists with this file's `Drawer` root; under a plain Radix `Root`, the panel animates with CSS keyframes and does not drag.
